source: RI-STL01 §2 §3 §4 §5 §6, transcribed verbatim. Perception geometry (cones, radii, decay, thresholds) is RI-AI01 §B and is NOT re-opened here.
note_on_units: Every rate is per SECOND in this file and is divided by 60 exactly once, in sim/stealth/detection.js, to reach f@60. Frame figures elsewhere in this piece carry the f@60 suffix per seam S22.

visibility.formula: V = clamp( L^gamma * M * S * E * A , 0.05 , 1.30 )

light_exponent_defect.ruling: RI-STL01 §2 STATES gamma = 0.7 and then publishes a five-row worked table that gamma = 0.7 cannot produce. gamma = 1.36 reproduces all five rows within 0.5%. The worked table is authoritative here and the stated exponent is a transcription defect. AMENDMENT-W1-15-01 files it.

row_4_crouched_unlit_light_Sneak45_cover.note: The item ANNOTATES this row as clamped at the 0.05 floor. At gamma = 0.7 the raw value is 0.0733 and the floor never fires, so the item's own annotation is false at its own stated exponent. This is the decisive tell.

arithmetic.rows_1_and_5: clamped at both exponents; they discriminate nothing.

light_exponent_defect.why_this_direction: gamma > 1 makes darkness matter MORE, which is the direction RI-STL01 §3 argues for in prose ('the lighting artist is a stealth designer') and the direction its DARK-COVERAGE metric assumes. At gamma 0.7 an L = 0.10 floor tile reads as V-multiplier 0.20; at 1.36 it reads 0.044.
light_exponent_defect.how_to_disagree: This value is DATA. Set it to 0.7 here, re-run tools/harness/stl-probe.mjs, and the five worked rows fail instead. Nothing in the code hardcodes it.

cover_A.cover_test: any collider between chest node and eye node for >= 60% of the cone

visibility.never_applies_to_note: Nothing hides you from being hit.

perception_inherited_from_RI_AI01.base_fill_at_R_note: fill = 150 * V * (1 - d/R) per second in the primary cone; the constant is set so the RI-STL01 §2 worked table reproduces exactly. See sim/stealth/detection.js baseFill().

light_table_L.condition: deep canopy, day (The Hive, Stone Forest)
torchlit interior, within 4 m of a flame
torchlit interior, 4-9 m from a flame

torch.note: L = max(L, 0.80) at all times while carried, and the torch is a hearing-independent alert source at 18 m.

light_falloff.model: inverse-square with a 0.35 m core, summed over sources, clamped to [0,1]
light_falloff.formula: L = clamp( ambient + sum_i( intensity_i / (0.35 + d_i^2) ) , 0, 1 )
light_falloff.note: The renderer and getLightAt() read this same function. RI-STL01's How-we-lose #1 is that light is never sampled at all; sim/stealth/light.js is the answer and getLightAt(x,y,z) is the instrument.

sound.discrete_events_note: None of the four is scaled by Sneak — they are not you moving. The throw is the only offensive stealth tool in the base kit and it directs alert at the impact point, not at you.

sneak_state.input_amendment: AM-W1-15-01 — added to the closed action set in game/src/input/actions.js
sneak_state.blocked_while: any enemy at alert_state == AGGRO within 8 m
sneak_state.blocked_while_note: You may not crouch your way out of an active fight; break line of sight and let RI-AI01's de-aggro run first.
sneak_state.opener_gate_note: RI-PRG03 §6. Deterministic. Below 20 the rear attack is an ordinary light attack that still HITS, because geometry decides hits (S1); it simply is not a critical.

civilian.formula: suspicion_fill = base_fill(V, distance, cone) * raceSuspicion[group][race] * contextWeight
civilian.note: Civilians NEVER use the enemy state machine. RI-STL01 How-we-lose: a shopkeeper who enters SUSPICIOUS then AGGRO collapses the whole crime system into combat and destroys the CHALLENGE off-ramp.

worked_rows.label: crouched, unlit, light, Sneak 45, in cover
still, unlit, light, Sneak 100, in cover

permitted_feedback: enemy 18 f@60 head-turn tell at SUSPICIOUS (RI-AI01 T02)
no_meter.rule: AR-2 / ui.hud.minimalism. The correct fix for 'I cannot tell if I am hidden' is more legible darkness and a clearer head-turn tell, never a HUD.
